title: Clone a Website
html:
Cloning a Website

For a phishing assessment sometimes it might be useful to completely clone/dump a website.

Note that you can add also some payloads to the cloned website like a BeEF hook to "control" the tab of the user.

There are different tools you can use for this purpose:

wget

The following command uses Wget's mirroring, page-requisite, link-conversion, and extension-adjustment modes, then serves the downloaded files from the current directory with Python's http.server module on port 8000.[1][2]

wget --mirror --page-requisites --convert-links --adjust-extension <URL>
cd <URL>
python3 -m http.server 8000

goclone

The goclone repository describes the utility as downloading a website to a local directory while preserving its relative link structure, and documents the goclone <url> invocation.[3]

#https://github.com/imthaghost/goclone
goclone <url>

Social Engineering Toolit

The Social-Engineer Toolkit (SET) repository identifies SET as an open-source penetration-testing framework for authorized social-engineering assessments.[4]

#https://github.com/trustedsec/social-engineer-toolkit

References

  • [1] GNU Wget Manual
  • [2] Python http.server documentation
